items.caption: The Pharaon comes into Marseilles; the shipowner is rowed out to meet her
items.to: “Ah, is it you, Dantès?” cried the man in the skiff

items.from: Very good; have what time you require, Dantès
items.caption: Dantès thanks M. Morrel for the promise of the captaincy

items.from: “Heaven pardon me,” cried Edmond, falling on his knees
items.caption: Edmond empties his purse on his father’s table
items.to: I will use your purse moderately

items.from: “You see, Mercédès,” said the young man
items.caption: Fernand pleads with Mercédès in the Catalan cottage
items.to: Fernand,” answered Mercédès, shaking her head

items.from: “Mercédès!” called a joyous voice from without
items.caption: Edmond embraces Mercédès while Fernand looks on
items.to: he extended the other to the Catalan

items.caption: Dantès on his knees before the inspector
items.to: Dantès fell on his knees, and prayed earnestly

items.from: the inspector gazed curiously into the chamber
items.caption: “You will not accept my gold; I will keep it for myself.”
items.to: You will not accept my gold; I will keep it for myself

items.from: The inspector kept his word with Dantès
items.caption: The inspector reads the note in the register
items.to: he simply wrote, “Nothing to be done.”
